title: Wave Feccii Ƴiiƴam
intro: Natal ilam mawɗam ina ummoo e dow leydi, Laana ndiwoowa ina ɓuuɓtoo ina ɓuuɓtoo, e ruuhu gooto heddii e yaasi e suɓaade. Haɓɓaaɗo e ƴiiƴam e annabi kono seerndi ɗum e goongɗinal, ooɗoo limoore ina jogori noddaango sakkitiingo ngam arde e laana nde ndiyam ɗam ɓuuɓnata. Mbele aɗa waawi udditaade ko woni caggal salaare ndee ?
clues: Miin ko mi iwdi gooto e annabaaɓe Alla ɓurɓe mawnude, galle iimanaagal mo cuɓ-mi yaltude.
Mi wuurii e jamaanu ilam mawɗam, nde keefeeraagal ɓuuɓni leydi no ndiyam nii.
Mi salii naatde e Laana kaa e gooŋɗinɓe nde baaba am noddi mi.
Mbi’mi miɗo ɗaɓɓa mooftude e dow tulde ngam hisnude mi e ndiyam.
Mi wiyaama wonde alaa fof ko waawi reenaade e kuulal Alla ñalnde heen so wonaa yurmeende.
Mi he6ii 6uu6ol, mi 6uuccii, baaba am wi’aa mi jeyaaka e galle makko peewcfo.

identity.label: Hol ko ngonmi?
options: Zayd ɓii Harita
Annabi Ishaq Ɓii Annabi Ibrahiima
Ɓiɗɗo Annabi Nuuhu mo keefeero
Habil, Ɓiɗɗo Annabi Aadama
Annabi Ismaa'il Ɓiɗɗo Annabi Ibraahiima

trial.label: Ñaawoore/Kewu
options: Yeeyde maccungaagu to leydi Ejipt caggal nde banndiraaɓe njanfi ɗum
Jaɓde naatde e Laana ndiwoowa e ɗaɓɓude tufnde ngam reentaade
Wereede e nder yiite ɓuuɓnge ngam ɓuuɓnude sanamuuji
Muusde liɗɗi mawɗi caggal nde dogi misiyoŋ
Ɗaanaade teeminanɗe e nder ngaska ngam daɗde e tooñanngeeji
trial.answer: Jaɓde naatde e Laana ndiwoowa e ɗaɓɓude tufnde ngam reentaade

location.label: Elemen keyɗo
options: Palas miroir de gilaas ni Saba
Kees leɗɗe werlaa e maayo
Koɗol toowngol ngol ina ɗaɓɓa reentaade e Ilam
Bus ɓuuɓɗo e nder falnde ceniinde
Kaaba mahii ko suudu dewo
location.answer: Koɗol toowngol ngol ina ɗaɓɓa reentaade e Ilam

outcome.label: Keeɓal
options: Muuɗi leydi e ngalu ngam mawnikinaare
Hokkaama laamu jogiingu baawɗe dow henndu e jinneeji
Waɗi cooyngal e kisal no yiite wontiri jam
Ummitinaama e nguurndam haa asamaan, hisnaama e leggal bardugal
Njokkii e ilam e bayyinaango wonaa e galle peewal
outcome.answer: Njokkii e ilam e bayyinaango wonaa e galle peewal

arabic: وَنَادَىٰ نُوحٌۭ رَّبَّهُۥ فَقَالَ رَبِّ إِنَّ ٱبْنِى مِنْ أَهْلِى وَإِنَّ وَعْدَكَ ٱلْحَقُّ وَأَنتَ أَحْكَمُ ٱلْحَـٰكِمِينَ
verse: And Noah called to his Lord and said, "My Lord, indeed my son is of my family; and indeed, Your promise is true; and You are the most just of judges!" (11:45)
